description: A shell script containing tests for git merge behavior, including handling of untracked files, staged changes, renamed files, untracked subtrees, symlinks, and unborn branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup command after tests.
